answers.note: Only one listed side is named, and it stands denied. Consuming is denied in its stepwise form at step 0 only; the statement says nothing of later steps or of the run. E23 says of the same formation in the same web that it is ConsumingIn over the run. So the pair E23/E24 places the step notions (within renewal, not undermining) against the run notions (consuming, narrowing) on one formation. The docstring's reason 'since no dependence on the condition has formed' is not in the statement. The last two conjuncts (Adds, ¬ Retains) are about significance and rest on the handed-in `unrestricted`.
